dateline: BTS Weekend in Toronto — City renamed a stretch of Yonge Street 'BTS Boulevard' and proclaimed Aug 22-23 'BTS Weekend,' lighting the Toronto Sign purple (Aug 21); thousands of fans queued for merch outside Rogers Stadium ahead of BTS's first Canadian shows since 2018; 'SWIM' closed out a 20-week Hot 100 run, tying 'Butter's' record, after exiting the chart dated Aug 22
heroHeadline: Day 4,818: Toronto Proclaims 'BTS Weekend,' Renames Street as Fans Queue for Rogers Stadium Opener
heroSubtitle: August 22, 2026 is Day 4,818 since BTS's June 13, 2013 debut. On Aug 21, Toronto installed 20 'BTS Boulevard' signs along a stretch of Yonge Street in North York (through Sept 23) and Mayor Olivia Chow proclaimed Aug 22-23 'BTS Weekend,' with the Toronto Sign at Nathan Phillips Square lit purple, per the Korea Herald and City of Toronto — coinciding with the Toronto Korean Festival (Aug 21-23) at Mel Lastman Square. Thousands of fans lined up outside Rogers Stadium for tour merchandise, some arriving before 6 a.m., per CP24, ahead of BTS's two-night stand (Aug 22-23) — the group's first Canadian shows since 2018. Separately, 'SWIM' closed out its Billboard Hot 100 run at 20 consecutive weeks — tying, not surpassing, 'Butter's' record — after exiting the chart dated Aug 22. The tour advances after Toronto to Chicago's Soldier Field (Aug 27-28).
